title: Image Gallery block (v2)
description: v2-only block (allowedInPageTypes: image) — no v1 category equivalent, no backend schema existed prior to this file, so validation was silently skipped.

title.description: Optional per-photo heading shown above the caption. 30-char cap mirrors the legacy image category's main_page files[] title.

size.description: Bytes. Persisted by the uploader so the gallery page's side panel can report a total size, the same way audio_player's files[] do. The legacy image category's main_page files[] already allowed this key.

cardStyle.description: Root-level, distinct from formatting.cardStyle: WithCardEffect (shell/with-effect.tsx) always reads this cardStyle.effect regardless of where backgroundColor lives — see design-field-presets.ts's cardEffectField() comment. Pre-existing gap: cardEffectField() has been in image-gallery/definition.ts's designFields with no matching schema property here, so a strict publish with a card effect set would have 400'd — fixed alongside the layout property below (.ai/block-card-appearance-plan.md, qcg-frontend-next).
